info.title: Koperasi Platform API
info.description: This API is the backend system for a single cooperative management platform. It supports authentication, e-commerce, agricultural equipment rental, financial transactions, and member operations. The platform serves one cooperative. All users belong to the same cooperative. Only cooperative members (SELLER role) are allowed to sell products and rent out agricultural equipment.

post.description: Checkout the current cart and create an order in its initial pending state. Order creation does not mean payment succeeded. The cart may contain product items (PRODUCT_PURCHASE) or rental items (EQUIPMENT_RENTAL), and is cleared on success. For Midtrans payments, create the order first, then call the Midtrans payment endpoint; the order is updated after the provider webhook. Access: BUYER, SUPERADMIN.
Legacy/manual payment simulation. Transitions an existing pending order to paid or failed; this endpoint is separate from the Midtrans flow. Access: BUYER, SUPERADMIN.

post.description: Creates Snap transaction for EXISTING order. order_id is source of truth.

Public callback called by Midtrans; no JWT is required. The server must verify signature_key before applying the callback. Supported mappings are settlement to paid, pending to pending, and deny, expire, or cancel to failed.

UserRole.description: User role. SELLER represents a registered cooperative member with selling privileges. SUPERADMIN is platform owner/admin layer with full access.
